analysis.headline: Shares Your Data With Many Partners
analysis.quote: bunny.net does not share any personal data with third parties except when required for the service to function properly.

analysis.headline: Withdrawal Limited For Contractual Data
analysis.quote: The withdrawal applies only to data processed on the basis of consent. It does not affect data processed as necessary for the performance of a contract to which the data subject is a party, or data required to comply with legal obligations to which bunny.net is subject.

analysis.headline: Retains Data for Legal Obligations
analysis.quote: Personal data included in tax and accounting documents will be retained for the period required under applicable tax and accounting regulations.

analysis.headline: AI Processes Your Chat Data
analysis.quote: When using the Fluffee chat, our system leverages the OpenAI ChatGPT API to generate responses. Please note that this process involves the use of your data to help address your queries.

analysis.headline: Account Requires Your Personal Data
analysis.quote: Registration and account creation are not possible without submitting the required information.

analysis.headline: Tracks Your Anonymous Website Interactions
analysis.quote: This may include the name of the browser used, pages visited, and points of interest based on mouse heatmap technology.

analysis.headline: Policy Changes Without Notice
analysis.quote: This privacy policy is subject to change without prior notice.
